resources.string: Initialize Mercado Pago\'s SDK with a public key to use the features.
Core methods provides APIs for you to create a fully customizable checkout experience. Use this demo to learn more about the core methods and how to use them.

The public key cannot be empty

The Checkout feature offers a seamless payment experience without requiring any component building. You can leverage one of the default themes or customize your own to create a complete payment solution.
